We spent $40,000 and 4 months building a feature that exactly three people ever clicked. 📉

Instead of hiding behind textbook theories, our team had to swallow a hard pill about building in a vacuum. 💸

For the next launch, we skipped the long dev cycle entirely and tested a dummy button backed by a manual spreadsheet. ⚡

That scrappy test gave us clearer answers in 48 hours than months of coding, transforming our #ProductManagement process. 🧠 Modern #Startups don't need perfection—they need speed to genuine user insight.

🎯 Always validate real user intent before writing a single line of backend logic.
